plan.summary: This 4-week block fits an off-camp 12-week boxing cycle with one short S&C session per week and high skill work. Week 1 is used to establish simple bodyweight baselines for future progression, and the main build starts in Week 2. Because equipment is bodyweight only and sparring is a priority, the plan keeps one crisp full-body session each week with power first, then strength work, then trunk and brief conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic full-body strength and low-impact power with clean bodyweight patterns that do not interfere with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the same movement patterns with slightly harder variations and tighter work density while keeping recovery solid.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it faster with sharper jumps, throws-like actions, and low-fatigue speed work.
